datasets.name: SAMPOQ
datasets.notes: Real self-reported 10-K relationships; no country/industry/product fields; direction standardised to Supplier -> Customer; confidence 0.9.

datasets.name: IC-SPLC-v2
raw: datasets/raw/ic_splc/extracted/IC-SPLC-v2 A Supply Chain Structure Neo4j Data/IC-SPLC.dump
datasets.notes: Anonymised, LLM-extracted structure; 31,182 nodes have 128-d embeddings; 37 duplicate edge IDs; direction confidence 0.7.

datasets.name: AnonNet
datasets.notes: Anonymised real-world network; 4 self-loops dropped; direction not formally documented; confidence 0.8.

datasets.name: SynDelay
datasets.notes: Synthetic. Class semantics undocumented and flagged. 41 duplicate order-item pairs resolved with a row suffix.

datasets.name: Smart Logistics
datasets.notes: Provenance unknown. Leakage fields excluded. Do not assume real or synthetic.

datasets.name: GDELT
datasets.notes: Unverified news mentions. DOC API 7/8 keywords succeeded; factory shutdown rate-limited; GKG fallback used. Date range 2026-11-03 to 2026-11-10.

datasets.name: Disruption Monitoring (restricted)
datasets.notes: Non-commercial. Excluded from main graph and training. Scenarios are synthetic evaluation material.

embedding.source: IC-SPLC 128-d node embeddings; other nodes are zero-filled with an explicit mask in training/node_embeddings.parquet

label_availability.shipment_delay: available for 156,488 shipments (SynDelay synthetic 3-class, Smart Logistics binary)

node_risk_prediction.reason: No verified company-level risk labels were found.

shipment_delay_classification.label_semantics: SynDelay classes 0/1/2 are undocumented; Smart Logistics binary is direct.

known_limitations: Company identities are not cross-source resolved; IC-SPLC and AnonNet entities are anonymised.
No verified company-level risk labels exist in the acquired sources.
AnonNet direction is not formally documented.
SynDelay label semantics are undocumented; do not interpret classes as delay severity.
Restricted CC BY-NC disruption monitoring data is excluded from this graph and from training.
GDELT records are unverified news mentions, not confirmed disruptions.

evaluation.benchmark_description: The 1,117 items of the relevance benchmark (Chapter 4 and Appendix C): 120 positives and 997 negatives. N4-029, N4-127 and N4-186 failed the checks after regeneration and were not confirmed by the audit, so they were dropped.
evaluation.scenario_note: Scenarios are synthesised news articles with ground-truth references generated by the repository authors. They are not real observed disruptions.
